The overall machine is simple and straightforward, makes excellent ice, and is compact and sleek looking.  The product arrived in 2 days instead of 10 and the only reason I gave it 4 stars instead of 5 was because they sent me the previous (discontinued) model that was black, not red. We use a lot of ice! We have a fridge with an ice maker, which works great when it's just our family, but whenever we have guests--and that happens a lot--we run out, usually just when we are trying to get that last glass of water to take to bed. Sometimes we remember to buy a bag of ice if we have company coming, but that's always such a pain and that ice doesn't last long before taking on the "freezer" taste. This Della ice maker has been great! The selling point for me is that it makes a batch of the big ice cubes every 10 minutes. Now whenever we have guests, we just fill this baby with water and let it go. As long as it's running, there's always plenty of ice for everyone. When the guests leave, we just drain it, wipe it out, and save it for the next go around.

The only thing that I wish was better is the plug on the bottom. It's hard to find and pull out, and because it's basically just a piece of rubbery plastic, I'm nervous that it will be the first thing to break, which will make the machine completely unusable, because then it will leak everywhere. If that happens anytime soon, I'll definitely update this post.

I am tickled pink over this purchase. The Maker was delivered promptly, looks great, operates well and produces as advertised. My two questions to the seller were answered promptly and favorably. It produces 9 large cubes in approximately 5 minutes and they taste good and perform well in my beverage. Buyer should read the instruction manual and make sure they allow the Maker to set upright for at least an hour prior to placing in operation to allow the compressor lubricants to settle to the base and lubricate as designed. I was spending $3 daily for ice tea at lunch and takeout back to the office. Drink water at lunch now and pocket the $3. Payback on this Maker is 2 months for me. :-)
